index: Consumer Price Index (base year 2007 = 100), Central Bureau of Statistics, as the Central Bank of Sudan's Economic and Financial Statistics Review publishes it
note: Monthly: each year's mean is of its twelve months. The Central Bureau of Statistics' own site (cbs.gov.sd) doesn't answer from here; the Central Bank of Sudan prints the Bureau's index (its source: 'Central Bureau of Statistics') on the base 2007 = 100 in its Economic and Financial Statistics Review: 2021's months in the Review for the fourth quarter of 2021 (Table 'Consumer Price Index & Inflation Rates'), 2025's in the Review for January to December 2025 (Table No. 20). Both give December 2020 as 8,639.4 and December 2021 as 36,131.1, so the two are one series.
